ikara-flinders-ranges-1.name: Wilpena Pound
ikara-flinders-ranges-1.bio: A natural amphitheatre of mountains, called Ikara by the Adnyamathanha, at the heart of the national park.
notes: Inside Ikara-Flinders Ranges NP: parkPass 'ikara-flinders' (vehicle entry $14.40, parks.sa.gov.au, read 2026-10-25); the pass must be added to src/data/parkPasses.ts.

notes.pin: Draft 3-decimal point is a memory pin, dropped. Pound is an area: use a visitor point (Wangara Lookout -31.542369,138.586662 per Wikivoyage, or the Wilpena trailhead) NOT the Wilpena Visitor Centre (-31.527039,138.606487), which is the destination's hub. Wikipedia article 'Wilpena Pound' is this place.

ikara-flinders-ranges-2.name: St Mary Peak
ikara-flinders-ranges-2.bio: At 1,171 m the highest peak in the Flinders Ranges, climbed on a steep full-day walk from Wilpena.
ikara-flinders-ranges-2.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: osm natural=peak (nominatim) "Saint Mary Peak"
notes: Wikivoyage notes the Adnyamathanha consider the peak sacred and ask that it not be climbed; not in the bio (single source, wording is the Wikivoyage editor's). Height 1,171 m from Wikipedia (Wikivoyage says 1,189 m).

notes.pin: Peak summit is the draft point; for a hike the rule says route midpoint, but this spot is the peak itself: summit unless the pin pass prefers the OSM route midpoint (route runs from the Wilpena trailhead; Wikivoyage: along the NE edge outside the Pound or through it).

ikara-flinders-ranges-3.name: Brachina Gorge
ikara-flinders-ranges-3.bio: A 20 km self-drive geological trail through 130 million years of earth history, with rock-wallabies in the gorge.
ikara-flinders-ranges-3.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: OSM node 925557559 tourism=viewpoint 'Brachina Gorge Geology Trail'; Brachina East Camp Ground n775893672 at -31.3337,138.5794  ""
notes: Trail best travelled east to west from the Brachina Gorge/Blinman Road junction (flindersandoutback listing). Yellow-footed rock-wallabies seen at the Scree Slope in late afternoon (NPWS ranger tip).
CLOSURE at read time (NPWS alert, 2026-10-25): Brachina Gorge Road open to 4WD vehicles only after heavy rain.

notes.pin: Pin at the midpoint of the 20 km trail along Brachina Gorge Road (OSM way). Wikivoyage Brachina Lookout, a stop on the trail, is -31.343442,138.555188.

ikara-flinders-ranges-4.name: Bunyeroo Gorge
ikara-flinders-ranges-4.bio: A gum-lined gorge with a scenic drive, a 7.5 km return walk and the Razorback lookout over Wilpena Pound.
ikara-flinders-ranges-4.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: OSM way 79365535 'Bunyeroo Gorge Walking Track' (gorge track; Bunyeroo Gorge Car Park way 118710739 at -31.416716,138.557971)  ""
notes: Visit range widened from the draft (1-2 h) to 1-3 h to cover the 3.5 h return gorge hike.
CLOSURE at read time (NPWS alert, 2026-10-25): Bunyeroo Gorge on Bunyeroo Gorge Road remains closed pending repair works after heavy rain.

notes.pin: Bunyeroo car park is 18 km north of Wilpena on Bunyeroo Gorge Road (NPWS walks list). Razorback Lookout, on Bunyeroo Rd, per Wikivoyage -31.4108,138.5834 (4 dp): the lookout may be a separate spot in another shard; keep this pin on the gorge itself.

ikara-flinders-ranges-5.name: Ediacaran Golden Spike
ikara-flinders-ranges-5.bio: A plaque marking the global start of the Ediacaran Period, a short walk from Trezona campground.
ikara-flinders-ranges-5.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: OSM node 8756762329 "Golden Spike" at the end of OSM path way 79234928 (Trezona Hike) in Brachina Gorge area Trezona loop; Wikivoyage Trezona Loop geotag -31.33147,138.635291 is 180 m east  ""
notes: Draft 'wiki: Ediacaran' dropped: that article is the geological period, not this place (a Commons/photo lookup on it would show fossils).
NPWS (Trezona campground page): the campground is a short walk from the internationally significant Ediacaran Golden Spike. The marker is a plaque in the rock, not a spike (secondary web source).

notes.pin: Wikivoyage geotag is specific to the listing; Trezona Campground is ~40 km north of Wilpena on Brachina Gorge Road. Cross-check against OSM.

ikara-flinders-ranges-6.name: Arkaroo Rock
ikara-flinders-ranges-6.bio: Adnyamathanha ochre and charcoal paintings telling the creation story of Wilpena Pound, on a 3 km return walk.
ikara-flinders-ranges-6.coordinates_source: resolve-pin HIGH: osm historic=archaeological_site (nominatim) "Arkaroo Rock Aboriginal paintings"
notes: NPWS: Arkaroo Rock Hike 2 hrs return, 3 km, car park 17 km south of Wilpena on the Hawker-Blinman road; paintings best seen in morning light. Site is Akurra Adnya, a significant Adnyamathanha site. Wikivoyage's 'about 6,000 years old' (carbon dated) is dropped from the bio for want of a second source.

notes.pin: Geotag may be the rock art site; the car park is the trailhead. A walk's rule says route midpoint: the Arkaroo Rock Hike is the route, the rock art its end. Pin pass to decide.

ikara-flinders-ranges-7.name: Sacred Canyon
ikara-flinders-ranges-7.bio: Adnyamathanha rock engravings in a canyon, seen on a guided cultural walk that needs a 4WD to follow.
ikara-flinders-ranges-7.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: OSM node 6043953647 historic=archaeological_site (the engravings), 220 m WSW of the Wikivoyage geotag (-31.5989,138.7018) where two OSM car parks (-31.5993,138.7018) sit  ""
notes: Access is restricted: NPWS lists Yura Mulka (Sacred Canyon) as restricted access, visited on an Adnyamathanha-guided tour through a commercial operator (Wilpena Pound Resort, and Wadna which closes over summer).

Prices read 2026-10-25: Wilpena Pound Resort tour from AUD 130 adult (wilpenapound.rezdy.com, ~3 hours incl. two 30-minute drives and a 2 km walk, 4x4 tag-along required); Wadna tour AUD 120 adult (wadna.com.au/sacred-canyon-tour, 4WD tag-along). Range 120-130 stored.
Tour price is the guide; the park vehicle entry fee ($14.40) is separate and is not stored on the spot.

notes.pin: Canyon is 13.5 km off Flinders Ranges Way along Sacred Canyon Rd (Wikivoyage); geotag is the listing's own.

ikara-flinders-ranges-7.ticket_note: Two independent operators sell the guided tour (Wilpena Pound Resort and Wadna); no single official site, so no ticketUrl.

ikara-flinders-ranges-8.name: Rawnsley Bluff
ikara-flinders-ranges-8.bio: A steep climb to the 950 m southern bluff of Wilpena Pound, starting inside Rawnsley Park Station.
notes: Not a NPWS-managed walk: the trail starts from the car park inside Rawnsley Park Station (private land adjoining the park), 11.3 km return, about 5 hours return to the bluff, with Wilpena Pound Lookout on a left fork 600 m before it (walkingsa.org.au). Bluff height 950 m (Wikipedia).

UNVERIFIED whether the station charges self-guided walkers; it sells guided walks from AUD 125 pp (rawnsleypark.com.au). Stored as free/open with no park pass because the trailhead is on station land; confirm access terms.

notes.pin: Draft 6 dp point is Wikipedia's coordinate for the bluff (a summit): fine as a summit pin. Trail start is the Rawnsley Park Station car park.

ikara-flinders-ranges-9.name: Old Wilpena Station
ikara-flinders-ranges-9.bio: Restored 1851 pastoral station with a self-guided interpretive trail, open daily from 8am to 5pm.
ikara-flinders-ranges-9.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: OSM node 772439524 tourism=attraction 'Wilpena Homestead' (old station homestead); Wilpena Station Woolshed node 772439525 is 290 m SE, quill point 215 m NE  ""
notes: Draft 'wiki: Wilpena Station' dropped: that title redirects to an unrelated biography (Henry Strong Price). Hills Homestead is the Hills Homestead Walk (ikara-flinders-ranges-10), a separate spot.
NPWS: station established 1851, worked 135 years, retired 1985; open 8am-5pm daily; Old Wilpena Woolshed hireable ($149 first day) is not a visitor cost.

ikara-flinders-ranges-10.name: Hills Homestead Walk
ikara-flinders-ranges-10.bio: A 6.6 km return walk inside Wilpena Pound to the preserved pioneer sites at Hills Homestead.
ikara-flinders-ranges-10.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: Length midpoint of the chained OSM paths Pound Gap Track (way 37192770, 28727636) + Wilpena Pound Hiking Track (ways 120134700, 120134696, 28727424) from Wilpena visitor centre to Hills Homestead ruins n696606489 (-31.5467,138.5889)  ""
notes: NPWS: easy walk, 2 hrs return, 6.6 km, 'pioneering heritage inside Wilpena Pound'; the Wangara Lookout hike branches from it (lookout at 7.2 km return, Wikivoyage listing geotag for Wangara Lookout -31.542369,138.586662).

notes.pin: Pin at the midpoint of the OSM route from the Wilpena trailhead to Hills Homestead; the trail starts near the Wilpena Visitor Centre complex (-31.527039,138.606487) which is the destination hub, not this spot's pin.

ikara-flinders-ranges-11.name: Hucks Lookout
ikara-flinders-ranges-11.bio: Roadside lookout over rocks laid down as sediments a billion to 500 million years ago, with a picnic area.
notes: Single counted source (Wikivoyage). On the Flinders Ranges Way east of the Pound; car park and picnic area per Wikivoyage.

ikara-flinders-ranges-12.name: Stokes Hill Lookout
ikara-flinders-ranges-12.bio: Lookout east over the ranges, with signs on Adnyamathanha art sites and how people used the land.
ikara-flinders-ranges-12.coordinates_source: resolve-pin HIGH: osm tourism=viewpoint (nominatim) "Stokes Hill Lookout"
notes: Lookout road leaves the Flinders Ranges Way near Willow Springs on the park's eastern edge; confirm it lies inside the park boundary (if outside, the park pass does not apply: the pin pass can check against the park polygon). Draft bio said 'near Wilpena' with views of the Pound; Wikivoyage gives an easterly view and Adnyamathanha interpretive signs, so the bio follows that.

ikara-flinders-ranges-13.name: Rawnsley Park Station
ikara-flinders-ranges-13.bio: Station near Wilpena Pound with the Woolshed Restaurant, scenic and helicopter flights, and walking trails.
ikara-flinders-ranges-13.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: OSM node 3069589536 place=locality 'Rawnsley Park Station' (kiosk node 431409993 at -31.645062,138.579803; chalet node 1316140815 -31.649772,138.593118)  ""

notes.pin: Station entrance off Flinders Ranges Way south of Wilpena; use the homestead/Woolshed Restaurant point.
notes.other: Scenic flights from AUD 220 pp (20 min) on the station site; no gate fee stated, so recorded as free entry (restaurant/flights are paid extras).

ikara-flinders-ranges-14.name: Trezona Hike
ikara-flinders-ranges-14.bio: An 8 km, four-hour hike through the Heysen Range past the Ediacaran Trezona formation.
ikara-flinders-ranges-14.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: Midpoint along chained OSM ways named "Trezona Hike" (w119031467 etc, ~5.8 km loop from Trezona Campground -31.3310,138.6277); way vertex  ""

notes.pin: Route midpoint of the Trezona loop. Wikivoyage geotags: Trezona Loop Walk -31.33147,138.635291; Trezona Campground (trailhead) -31.33198,138.62494.
notes.other: Inside Ikara-Flinders Ranges NP: park vehicle entry AUD 14.40 per vehicle (park page). Ediacaran Golden Spike nearby is separate.

ikara-flinders-ranges-15.name: Skytrek 4WD Track
ikara-flinders-ranges-15.bio: An 80 km, seven-hour self-drive 4WD track across Willow Springs Station with Upalinna Lookout views of Wilpena Pound.
ikara-flinders-ranges-15.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: Halfway point (38 km) round the closed loop of four OSM ways named "Skytrek" (76 km total), measured from the vertex nearest Willow Springs Station camp_site node 1811204993  ""

notes.pin: Willow Springs Station Caretaker's Office (track start), 16430 Flinders Ranges Way; or middle of the 80 km loop at Upalinna Lookout if findable.
notes.other: AUD 90 per vehicle (up to 6 persons); AUD 60 listed for a lower rate (likely station guests); must start by 10am; AUD 85 club outing. Renamed from SkyTrek Willow Springs Station (the place is the track; station is the operator).

ikara-flinders-ranges-16.name: Jarvis Hill Lookout
ikara-flinders-ranges-16.bio: Lookout about 7 km west of Hawker with views of the town, Wilpena Pound and the Elder Range.
ikara-flinders-ranges-16.ticket_note: Open lookout on a council road; the tourism listing links the Flinders Ranges Council tourism page (frc.sa.gov.au/tourism), which blocks scripts, so no single steward page verified.
ikara-flinders-ranges-16.coordinates_source: resolve-pin HIGH: osm tourism=viewpoint (nominatim) "Jarvis Hill Lookout"

notes.pin: Car park at the top of Jarvis Hill, ~6 km along the signposted road off Quorn/Leigh Road ~200 m from Wilpena Road turn; pin on the hill, not Hawker.
notes.other: Dirt clay road, not for use when wet. Renamed from Jarvis Hill Lookout and Walking Trail (category viewpoint).

ikara-flinders-ranges-17.name: Castle Rock
ikara-flinders-ranges-17.bio: Castle-shaped rock 2 km east of Hawker, reached by a short walking track and best in early or late light.
ikara-flinders-ranges-17.ticket_note: Open walk with no single steward page.

notes.pin: Gate and walking track at the top of the Desalination Plant road off Wilpena Road ~1 km from Hawker; track midpoint toward Castle Rock.
notes.other: Renamed from Castle Rock Walk and Lookout. Avoid Yednalue Drive when wet.

ikara-flinders-ranges-18.name: Camel Hump Lookout
ikara-flinders-ranges-18.bio: Easy short climb 2 km south of Hawker on Quorn Road to a lookout over the town and the ranges.
ikara-flinders-ranges-18.ticket_note: Open walk with no single steward page.
ikara-flinders-ranges-18.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: OSM node 8211873217 tourism=viewpoint 'Camels hump lookout' (Hawker)  ""

notes.pin: Track start on Quorn Road ~2 km south of Hawker; lookout on the hump itself.
notes.other: Renamed from Camel Hump Lookout Walk.

ikara-flinders-ranges-20.name: Hawker Mural Trail
ikara-flinders-ranges-20.bio: Self-guided mural walk through Hawker telling Adnyamathanha Dreaming stories, with English and Adnyamathanha labels.
ikara-flinders-ranges-20.ticket_note: Self-guided town trail with no single steward page.
ikara-flinders-ranges-20.coordinates_source: resolve-pin LOW: OSM node 2300348834 place=town 'Hawker' (town centre; individual murals are not mapped)  (provisional)

notes.pin: Middle of the mural route in Hawker town centre.
notes.other: Listing address says Quorn (Railway Terrace) but the text places the trail in Hawker; murals by Juanella McKenzie. Renamed from Adnyamathanha Dreaming Hawker Mural Walking Trail.

ikara-flinders-ranges-22.name: Blinman Heritage Mine
ikara-flinders-ranges-22.bio: Guided tour through tunnels worked by Cornish miners from 1862, with a self-guided walk above ground.

notes.pin: Mine Road, Blinman (mine entrance).
notes.other: Operator site: adult AUD 40 (the tourism listing's older AUD 35 is superseded). Tours hourly, about one hour.

ikara-flinders-ranges-23.name: Prairie Hotel
ikara-flinders-ranges-23.bio: Parachilna pub known for a menu of native and feral foods such as emu and goat.
ikara-flinders-ranges-23.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: OSM node 1243289827 amenity=pub "Prairie Hotel"  ""

notes.pin: Hotel at Parachilna, corner of Flinders Ranges Way.
notes.other: Free to enter; meals are paid extras. Keep as landmark pub (judge kept it).

ikara-flinders-ranges-24.name: Parachilna Gorge
ikara-flinders-ranges-24.bio: Scenic gorge drive between Blinman and Parachilna with free camping.
ikara-flinders-ranges-24.ticket_note: Public gorge road with no single steward page.
ikara-flinders-ranges-24.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: Wikipedia 'Parachilna Gorge' article point (the gorge itself); Parachilna Gorge Road way 1568750988 runs through it  ""

notes.pin: Gorge road mid-point between Blinman and Parachilna; Wikipedia coordinates are the gorge's own.
notes.other: Wikipedia article is the gorge itself.

ikara-flinders-ranges-25.name: Blinman Pools
ikara-flinders-ranges-25.bio: Walk of about 12 km return from Angorichina Village in Parachilna Gorge to two natural rock pools.
ikara-flinders-ranges-25.ticket_note: no single steward page verified; the walk is in Ikara-Flinders Ranges National Park (parks.sa.gov.au page has no Blinman Pools sub-page, 404)
ikara-flinders-ranges-25.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: Length midpoint of chained OSM ways 311504885 + 1568750987 'Blinman Pools Walking Trail' (5.8 km, Angorichina Village n1811159319 to the pools way 815702565)  ""

notes.pin: Linear route: pin at middle of the Blinman Pools Walking Trail (OSM hiking route); trailhead at Angorichina Village on Parachilna Gorge Road; about 12 km return, pools at ~5-6 km. Draft says hike starts at Parachilna; guides (Prairie Hotel, trailhiking) start at Angorichina.
notes.cost: Unverified whether the Ikara-Flinders Ranges NP vehicle fee ($14.40 per vehicle, parks.sa.gov.au) applies on this northern section; set free pending check.

quorn-1.name: Pichi Richi Railway
quorn-1.bio: South Australia's oldest operating heritage railway, running steam trains between Quorn and Port Augusta.
quorn-1.coordinates_source: resolve-pin HIGH: osm tourism=attraction (nominatim) "Pichi Richi Railway"

notes.pin: Quorn railway station (Railway Terrace), the Quorn terminus; draft point is the Wikipedia point, confirm it is on the station.
notes.cost: Afghan Express adult return $126 (pichirichirailway.org.au/train-services/timetable); adult one-way $97. Tourism listings show older $122. Runs on selected Saturdays only, check the timetable; Coffee Pot rail experience is a separate higher-priced product.

quorn-2.name: Warren Gorge
quorn-2.bio: Rocky gorge 21 km north of Quorn with a 5 km creek walk and yellow-footed rock-wallabies at dawn and dusk.
quorn-2.ticket_note: steward is the Flinders Ranges Council (frc.sa.gov.au) which blocks scripts; needs browser check
quorn-2.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: OSM way 1000271570 highway=path 'Warren Gorge Loop Trail' (north of the Warren Gorge campground node 1811203220 at -32.182621,138.007467)  ""

notes.pin: Gorge itself is just beyond the entrance campground on Arden Vale Road, 21 km N of Quorn; the 5.2 km creek walk starts at the campground (pin mid-gorge or at the entrance campground).
notes.cost: Day entry $5 per vehicle, self-registration at the gorge or at Quorn visitor centre (flindersandoutback.com.au listing, council-run).

quorn-3.name: Dutchmans Stern Conservation Park
quorn-3.bio: Bluff 10 km north-east of Quorn with a summit trail and views over Spencer Gulf and the Willochra Plain.

notes.pin: Wikipedia point is the bluff; use the park's trailhead/car park (trailhead altitude 440 m, ridgetop walk 4.1 km one way, loop 10.5 km) as the visitor point.
notes.cost: Parks SA page: free entry.
notes.alert: Parks SA alerts at fetch: entrance road 4WD/AWD only after storm damage; park closed 6pm 31 Oct to 6pm 6 Nov 2026 for pest control.

quorn-4.name: Mount Brown Conservation Park
quorn-4.bio: Conservation park around a 964 m peak, with a lookout and a 15 km loop walk.

notes.pin: Wikipedia point is the park/peak; use the lookout or the loop-walk trailhead car park from Parks SA/OSM.
notes.cost: Parks SA page: free entry.
notes.alert: Closed 31 Oct to 6 Nov 2026 for pest control (Parks SA alert).

quorn-5.name: Kanyaka Station Ruins
quorn-5.bio: Stone ruins of a cattle and sheep station from the 1850s, with a woolshed, homestead and Death Rock waterhole nearby.
quorn-5.ticket_note: no single official site; listing is by tourism board only
quorn-5.coordinates_source: resolve-pin HIGH: OSM node 3324941769 Kanyaka Station (historic=ruins, tourism=attraction) + Wikipedia-based draft -32.07257,138.29965 within 2 m  ""

notes.pin: Draft is the Wikipedia point; the ruins' car park off Quorn-Hawker Road. Death Rock and Kanyaka Waterhole are a separate stop ~10 min walk, off the road just past Wirreanda Creek Bridge, 33 km N of Quorn: must not share a pin.
notes.cost: No fee shown on the tourism listings (free assumed from listing facilities: carpark, picnic area); no managing-agency page found.
notes.sources: Wikipedia Kanyaka Station (established February 1852, abandoned after droughts)

port-augusta-1.name: Wadlata Outback Centre
port-augusta-1.bio: Interpretive centre whose Tunnel of Time walks through Aboriginal and European outback history, in Port Augusta.
port-augusta-1.coordinates_source: resolve-pin HIGH: OSM way 315303740 "Wadlata Outback Centre" (tourism=information, building) centre; hint point (-32.4925,137.76583) within 30 m  ""

notes.pin: 41 Flinders Terrace, Port Augusta (building itself).
notes.cost: Adult $29.00 for the Tunnel of Time, 1 Jul 2026 to 30 Jun 2027 (wadlata.sa.gov.au costs page). Older sources show $18.50-$19.50. Centre also houses the visitor information centre.

port-augusta-2.name: Australian Arid Lands Botanic Garden
port-augusta-2.bio: Arid-zone botanic garden on Stuart Highway with interpretive walks through desert plants on red sand.
port-augusta-2.coordinates_source: resolve-pin HIGH: OSM way 119997344 'Australian Arid Lands Botanical Gardens Visitor Centre' (tourism=attraction); quill/Wikivoyage -32.4616,137.7432 within 40 m  ""

notes.pin: 144 Stuart Highway, Port Augusta West; use the visitor centre/main car park (Wikivoyage point -32.4656,137.7399 differs by ~600 m from draft).
notes.cost: Free entry with donation boxes (flindersandoutback.com.au listing); gates open daily 7:30am to sunset (not stored).

port-augusta-3.name: Port Augusta Water Tower Lookout
port-augusta-3.bio: The 1882 Westside water tower, with a balcony view over the town, Spencer Gulf and the Flinders Ranges.
port-augusta-3.ticket_note: council-run; port augusta council site blocks scripts
port-augusta-3.coordinates_source: resolve-pin HIGH: osm tourism=viewpoint (nominatim) "Water Tower Lookout"

notes.pin: Wikivoyage lists Mitchell Terrace / Gold Street, Port Augusta West at -32.485152,137.752534 (the tower itself; the Wikivoyage listing coordinates are specific to it). Four flights of steps.
notes.cost: No fee mentioned in either source; unverified (assumed free).

port-augusta-4.name: Port Augusta Foreshore
port-augusta-4.bio: Sandy foreshore beach at high tide, with a short jetty into deep water, cold showers and change rooms.
port-augusta-4.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: osm leisure=playground (nominatim) "East Side Foreshore"

notes.pin: OSM natural=beach/jetty on the Port Augusta foreshore at the jetty.
notes.cost: Open access; Wikivoyage warns of a tide current in deeper water.

port-augusta-5.name: Blanche Harbor
port-augusta-5.bio: Rehabilitated shore at the end of Shack Road, 23 km from town, for picnics and watching mulga parrots and emus.
port-augusta-5.coordinates_source: resolve-pin LOW: South end of OSM way 102603568 'Shack Road' (the road Blanche Harbor lies at the end of)  (provisional)

notes.pin: End of Shack Road, about 23 km from the Port Augusta centre (Wikivoyage); look for an OSM picnic/place point named Blanche Harbor.
notes.cost: Open access.

port-pirie-1.name: Port Pirie Heritage Trail
port-pirie-1.bio: Self-guided trail past more than 30 sites, including the smelter, grand hotels and civic buildings, by foot or car.
port-pirie-1.coordinates_source: resolve-pin LOW: OSM node 738227219 'Port Pirie Regional Tourism and Arts Centre', where the council story map starts  (provisional)

notes.pin: A linear walk: take the midpoint of the route. Third-party listing (walkingsa.org.au) calls it a 3.5 km circuit, 1-2 hr; the council story map starts at the Port Pirie Regional Tourism & Arts Centre. Must not share a pin with the mural trail or the museum.
notes.cost: Maps free from the visitor centre and online.

port-pirie-2.name: Port Pirie Mural Trail
port-pirie-2.bio: A two-kilometre, map-guided walk past large murals in Port Pirie's centre, starting at the visitor centre.
port-pirie-2.coordinates_source: resolve-pin LOW: OSM node 738227219 Port Pirie Regional Tourism and Arts Centre (tourism=information), the trail start on Mary Elie Street  (provisional)

notes.pin: Start: Port Pirie Visitor Information Centre, Mary Elie Street; trail runs through the CBD (a route, pin at its middle).
notes.source: flindersandoutback.com.au/listings/attraction/port-pirie-mural-trail/ (launched 2017, council-run, 2 km, map from visitor centre)
notes.pin_moved: pin moved 35 m north so it does not sit on port-pirie-1

port-pirie-2.ticket_note: Only the Port Pirie Regional Council page (pirie.sa.gov.au/about-council) is linked and it is behind a Cloudflare wall; not verified

port-pirie-3.name: Port Pirie National Trust Museum
port-pirie-3.bio: Three heritage buildings, including the 1902 railway station, with a steam shunting engine and Diprotodon bones.
port-pirie-3.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: OSM node 1456474142 tourism=museum "Port Pirie Railway Station Museum"  ""

notes.pin: Museum at 73-77 Ellen Street, Port Pirie (National Trust: 73 Ellen Street; SAcommunity: 77 Ellen St); pin at the railway-station building, not the town centre.
notes.cost: National Trust page: museum 'donations welcome'; the Immersive Sound and Light Show in the Customs House is a separate ticket (adult $11, concession $8, child $5, family $25). Open Tue-Sat 10am-4pm (not in bio).

port-pirie-4.name: Solomontown Beach
port-pirie-4.bio: A pier and man-made beach on the Port Pirie river with swimming, showers and change rooms.

notes.pin: OSM natural=beach / pier at Solomontown (Port Pirie south); take the beach feature, not the suburb point.
notes.source: Wikivoyage Port Pirie: 'a nice pier, man-made beach and swimming spot... showers and change rooms'; caution about strong tides

port-pirie-4.ticket_note: No single steward page found; omitted

port-pirie-5.name: Port Germein Jetty
port-pirie-5.bio: At about 1.5 km, Port Germein's wooden jetty is the longest in South Australia and a favourite for crabbing.
